charset=utf-8'} else: abort(404) except Exception: abort(404) @app.route('/profile-photo/', methods=['GET']) def get_profile_photo(username): try: with get_db() as conn: # Parameterized query prevents SQL Injection row = conn.execute('SELECT profile_photo FROM profiles WHERE username = ?', (username,)).fetchone() if row: return send_file( BytesIO(row['profile_photo']), mimetype='image/png' ) else: abort(404) except Exception: abort(404) if __name__ == '__main__': init_db() # Run on 0.0.0.0:5000 as requested app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
